method: scripts/arm-gate-probe.mjs, extended this session (runDailyFortuneScenario). Real touch only (Input.dispatchTouchEvent via scripts/driver.mjs's session.tap, never .click()). Each control's rect is learned in an untimed dry run, then a real cause tap + a second real contact gapMs later (100ms and 500ms) are fired via the un-awaited-dispatch trick already proven in this file for short-stick/timebomb (session.tap() dispatches synchronously before its own internal ~400ms settle sleep, so two un-awaited calls plus an explicit setTimeout(gapMs) land genuinely gapMs apart). The chip-exception check reuses the same technique instead of wall-clock Date.now() around an awaited tap, because session.tap()'s own internal settle sleep makes any Date.now()-wrapped measurement read >=400ms regardless of real behaviour (browser-verification.md trap #2 — an early draft of this check used Date.now() and always read false; caught and fixed before this capture).
